end.summary:
Reyansh practised identifying top and side views of cones, cylinders, and similar solids.
They described a cone from the side as triangular and a cylinder from the side as rectangular.
They matched one top/front/side view to its object correctly without help.
Top-view descriptions for a cone and cylinder were revisited several times; the teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing solid shapes from the top and side, using familiar objects such as a steel glass, cooker lid, and pointed hat. They clearly explained that a cone looks triangular from the side and a cylinder looks like a long rectangle from the side. There was a mix-up about top views: Reyansh said a cone and cylinder both look circular from above, but this was not corrected by the end. At home, show a cup, tin, and cone-shaped object and ask Reyansh to draw each view from the top, front, and side.
